rows.text: Charged $14.99 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.

Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that's a really generous offer, and a data analyst is exactly what we need. The project I'm leaning towards is a carefully sourced dataset tracking the public safety commitments frontier AI developers have made (eval pledges, deployment conditions, disclosure promises, etc.) and the public evidence on whether they've been kept. Every row cites and archives a primary source; assessments need two reviewers; developers get a right of reply. The goal is a neutral record that journalists, researchers and regulators can rely on. If it appeals, the most useful first things would be: 1. Poke holes in the draft schema (two tables: commitments and evidence) — what's missing, what will be ambiguous in practice. 2. Help pilot it on one developer once the schema's settled, probably in December. No pressure to commit yet — I'll send the schema and plan over properly in the next week or so. Does that sound like the kind of thing you'd enjoy? Thanks again, Morgan (Sent with help from my AI assistant.)"
rows.quote: Replied to Priya: I thanked her, described the project, and asked her to critique the data layout and help test it on one lab in December. The email notes that your AI assistant helped write it.
